words: A message sent to the player's inbox from the back office. Used by many tasks (Grace, LTV, Top PNL, Risk Push and more); this SOP is how you send one.
Who gets the mail: All User (everyone) or a specific group (for example a player level). It cannot be undone after sending.
The three Zyra language versions: English, Chinese and Malay. Zyra will not create the message until all three are filled.
The subject and content you paste exactly. Changes need TL approval.
The backend system where you check and update player details.

tour.label: Check
tour.title: Before you press Send
items: The recipient matches the campaign (All User or the right group)
Brand and links are correct
Subject and content are pasted exactly from the approved template
Zyra: all three languages are filled
tour.done: All checked: send, then screenshot the confirmation at once.
tour.notYet: Fix it first. A mail to the wrong group cannot be undone.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Six steps
items: Open the send path
TC: Interact Management, Mail, Send Mail. Zyra: Notification, System Messages, Add Message.
Pick the recipient
All User for a general broadcast, or the specific group or player level for a targeted send.
Paste
Subject and content exactly from the approved template. Zyra: EN-MY, ZH-MY and MS-MY.
Double-check
Brand, links, content, recipient (Zyra: every language).
Send and screenshot
TC: Send. Zyra: Create. Screenshot the confirmation straight away.
QA Record
Attach the confirmation screenshot.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Send before checking the recipient scope. It cannot be undone.
Change the template wording without TL approval.
Skip the confirmation screenshot. No screenshot, no proof of send.
Keep quiet about a mistake you spot after sending. Tell the ATL or TL at once.

tour.label: TC vs Zyra
tour.title: The two back offices
items: TC path
Interact Management, Mail, Send Mail. Button: Send.
TC recipients
All User, or Specific Player Level for VIP-only sends.
Zyra path
Notification, System Messages, Add Message. Button: Create.
Zyra languages
EN-MY, ZH-MY and MS-MY, all three, or it will not create.

tour.label: After
tour.title: Spotted a mistake after sending?
tour.q: Did you find a wrong link or wrong content after the mail went out?
tour.yes: Report it to your ATL or TL immediately. Do not try to fix it quietly.
tour.no: Screenshot the confirmation and update the QA Record.

pool.q: On Zyra, you filled EN-MY and MS-MY but not ZH-MY. What happens?
o: Zyra will not create the message until all three are filled
pool.why: Zyra needs EN-MY, ZH-MY and MS-MY before it creates the message.

pool.q: You sent an IM to All User instead of Tier V only. Can you undo it?
o: Yes, recall it in the BO
No; that is why you check the recipient before sending
pool.why: Sending to the wrong group cannot be undone. Verify the recipient scope first, and report the mistake to the ATL or TL.

pool.q: The template has a small typo. Can you fix it before sending?
pool.why: Paste exactly from the approved template. Do not modify it without TL approval.

pool.q: When do you screenshot the confirmation screen?
o: At the end of the shift
pool.why: Screenshot immediately after sending. It is mandatory QA evidence.

pool.q: Where do you send Internal Mail on TC?
pool.why: TC: Interact Management, Mail, Send Mail. Zyra: Notification, System Messages, Add Message.

pool.q: On TC, how do you send to VIP players only?
pool.why: For VIP-only sends, select Specific Player Level. All User is a general broadcast.

pool.q: After sending, you notice the link points to the wrong page. What do you do?
o: Report it to your ATL or TL immediately
pool.why: A link or content error found after sending is reported to the ATL or TL at once.
